_comment: Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (user-wide) or .claude/settings.json (project). Replace PATH_TO_KHMS with the absolute path to your code clone - hook commands do not expand shell variables. Remove the _comment keys. PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure are deliberately absent: see claude-code/README.md and docs/measuring-injection.md.

PreToolUse._comment: The retrieval-claim gate. Replace the matcher with the tool through which your agent reports to its principal (a chat tool, a mail tool, a ticket tool); set KHMS_REPORT_TOOL to the same pattern. Remove this entry if you do not want reports gated.
